blocks.text: Kim Chiu seemingly made a playful response to rumors of her supposed pregnancy, as she dressed in a boyish outfit while sporting a fake baby bump. The actress-TV host shared via her Facebook page on Wednesday, Sept. 23, a clip featuring her wearing men’s clothes but with a visible bump on her tummy. It was not immediately known whether the outfit was for a shooting. Days earlier, Kim also posted a video of her dancing while donning the same outfit, which gained thousands of laugh reactions on Facebook.
